records.key: Gemini requires Node.js. On macOS and Linux, the command below installs Node.js and Gemini CLI in your user account. On Windows, install Node.js before running the npm command.
records.source: Gemini requires Node.js. On macOS and Linux, the command below installs Node.js and Gemini CLI in your user account. On Windows, install Node.js before running the npm command.
records.translation: Gemini krefst Node.js. Á macOS og Linux setur skipunin hér að neðan Node.js og Gemini CLI upp undir notandareikningnum þínum. Á Windows skaltu setja Node.js upp áður en npm-skipunin er keyrð.

records.key: Sign-in status is unavailable; use the CLI to confirm your account.
records.source: Sign-in status is unavailable; use the CLI to confirm your account.
records.translation: Staða innskráningar er ekki tiltæk; notaðu CLI til að staðfesta reikninginn þinn.

records.key: Copy the login command and run it in a terminal on this platform.
records.source: Copy the login command and run it in a terminal on this platform.
records.translation: Afritaðu innskráningarskipunina og keyrðu hana í skipanalínuglugga á þessu stýrikerfi.
